How it works

Collect → Plant refill → Return

Three honest beats. We never fill cooking gas on your street in Port Harcourt.

1
Collect

A rider picks up your empty cylinder from your Port Harcourt address. Nothing is filled at the door.

2
Plant refill

Your cylinder is refilled offsite at our plant — sealed, weighed, and checked before it comes back.

3
Return

The filled cylinder is returned to you. Track the loop, and ping WhatsApp if you need a hand.

Who we serve

One service, every kitchen in Port Harcourt

Households, food businesses, estates — the same sealed loop and the same live rate. We just meet you where you cook.

Households

One Sunday-jollof pot that never runs dry. We collect the empty, refill at the plant, and bring it back full — Diobu to Eliozu.

Food businesses & chefs

Buka, restaurant, or culinary school — keep every burner lit. Fill by the kg and get a same-day return so service never stops.

Estates & offices

Leave the empty with security at the gate. Estate and corporate accounts get the same sealed, weighed, plant-refilled cylinder back.

Coverage

Port Harcourt zones we ride

Pickup empty, plant refill, return full. Zone fees stay between ₦600 and ₦1,200. Hub self-collect is gas only.

Why GasGo

Why people refill with GasGo

Plant refill in Port Harcourt — your cylinder, your fill, one clear loop.

01
Pay once

We handle collect, plant refill, and return. One Paystack payment before the empty leaves.

02
Your cylinder stays yours

We fill the bottle you already own — offsite at the plant, then back to your door.

03
Flexible fill

Full, by kg, or by naira. Live Port Harcourt rate, zone fee as its own line.

04
Reliable Port Harcourt coverage

Old GRA to Trans-Amadi and the corridors we ride every day. Hub self-collect is gas only.
